book.title: Crit Hit & Run
invariants: No convenient amnesia as a continuity device.

chapters.title: Critical Failure to Launch
chapters.goal: Artie is isekai'd into the world of Aethelgard and discovers his 'Glitch-Crit' class during a tutorial fight gone wrong.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a mundane office worker to a high-variance combatant with a target on his back.

bridge.from_prev: The transition from Earth to the System interface.
bridge.to_next: Artie realizes his unique class requires rare resources only found in dangerous zones.

chapters.title: The Math of Murder-Hoboing
chapters.goal: Artie attempts to grind low-level mobs but accidentally triggers a recursive loot exploit that robs a local dungeon dry.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a struggling newbie to an accidental economic threat to the local town.

bridge.from_prev: Artie's need for resources leads him to the Whispering Woods dungeon.
bridge.to_next: The local Adventurers' Guild notices the sudden lack of loot and starts an investigation.

chapters.title: Grand Theft Artifact
chapters.goal: Artie is forced to steal a legendary 'Cooldown Reset' gem to keep his unstable class from self-destructing.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a simple looter to a high-profile criminal wanted by the city guard.

bridge.from_prev: The realization that his 'Glitch-Crit' class has a hidden stability meter.
bridge.to_next: Artie must flee the city before the 'System Sentinels' arrive to patch him out.

chapters.title: The Glass Cannon Run
chapters.goal: Artie navigates the 'Dead Zones'—areas where the System is buggy—to lose his pursuers.
chapters.stakes_shift: From fleeing a local guard to surviving a hostile, reality-warping environment.

bridge.from_prev: The narrow escape from the city gates.
bridge.to_next: Artie discovers a hidden sanctuary that holds the truth about his class's origin.

chapters.title: Optimization or Extinction
chapters.goal: A professional bounty hunter with a 'Nullification' build corners Artie, forcing him to fight without his exploits.
chapters.stakes_shift: From relying on glitches to proving his core tactical competence as a player.

bridge.from_prev: The discovery of the sanctuary is interrupted by the bounty hunter's arrival.
bridge.to_next: Artie wins but realizes the bounty hunter was just the scout for a larger guild.

chapters.title: The One-Percent Chance
chapters.goal: Artie raids the regional boss's lair to secure a permanent 'Stability Patch' item, facing overwhelming odds.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a hunted anomaly to a potential power player in the world's meta-narrative.

bridge.from_prev: The need to finalize his build before the 'System Sentinels' catch up.
bridge.to_next: The boss falls, but the resulting explosion of data alerts the entire world to Artie's location.

chapters.title: Outrunning the Patch Notes
chapters.goal: Artie secures his loot and escapes into the next region just as the System initiates a 'Zone Reset'.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a local glitch to a global phenomenon that the System itself is trying to delete.

bridge.from_prev: The defeat of the regional boss and the acquisition of the Stability Patch.
bridge.to_next: Artie sets his sights on the capital to find the source of the System's code.

sections.title: Office Space to Outer Space
sections.intent: Establish Artie's mundane life and the jarring transition to the System interface.
sections.end_condition: Artie completes the character creation process and stands in the world of Aethelgard.

sections.title: The Tutorial Bug
sections.intent: Introduce the combat system and reveal Artie's 'Glitch-Crit' during a scripted tutorial boss.
sections.end_condition: The tutorial boss is defeated via an unintended mechanical exploit.

sections.title: Resource Management
sections.intent: Highlight the instability of the class and the immediate need for rare resources.
sections.end_condition: Artie identifies the specific rare resources required to stabilize his class.

sections.title: The Grind is Real
sections.intent: Show Artie attempting to play the game normally before discovering a loot exploit.
sections.end_condition: Artie triggers a recursive loot loop in the Whispering Woods.

sections.title: Looting the World Dry
sections.intent: Demonstrate the absurdity of the exploit as Artie inadvertently strips the dungeon of all value.
sections.end_condition: The Whispering Woods dungeon is rendered completely empty of items and monsters.

sections.title: Market Crash
sections.intent: Show the consequences of Artie's actions on the local economy and the Guild's response.
sections.end_condition: Artie observes the Adventurers' Guild arriving to investigate the 'looted' dungeon.

sections.title: The Stability Tax
sections.intent: Heighten the stakes by showing Artie's class meter reaching a critical failure point.
sections.end_condition: Artie locates the 'Cooldown Reset' gem within the city's high-security vault.

sections.title: The Vault Heist
sections.intent: A comedic but high-stakes infiltration where Artie uses glitches to bypass security.
sections.end_condition: Artie successfully acquires the Cooldown Reset gem.

sections.title: Burn the Bridge
sections.intent: The chase through the city as Artie is identified as a criminal.
sections.end_condition: Artie escapes through the city gates with the guard in pursuit.

sections.title: Welcome to the Glitch
sections.intent: Introduce the 'Dead Zones' and their reality-warping mechanics.
sections.end_condition: Artie enters the heart of a Dead Zone where the System is visibly broken.

sections.title: Logic Errors
sections.intent: Survival against corrupted mobs and environmental bugs that test Artie's adaptability.
sections.end_condition: Artie survives a major reality-warping environmental hazard.

sections.title: Safe Mode
sections.intent: The discovery of a sanctuary that offers temporary respite and lore about his class.
sections.end_condition: Artie finds and enters the hidden sanctuary.

sections.title: The Anti-Glitched
sections.intent: Introduce the Bounty Hunter and the threat of 'Nullification'.
sections.end_condition: The Bounty Hunter successfully corners Artie and disables his glitch abilities.

sections.title: Back to Basics
sections.intent: A tactical fight where Artie must rely on fundamental player skill rather than exploits.
sections.end_condition: Artie defeats the Bounty Hunter using clever use of the environment.

sections.title: The Scout's Warning
sections.intent: Reveal that the hunter was only the beginning of a larger organized pursuit.
sections.end_condition: Artie realizes he is being hunted by a major guild.

sections.title: Storming the Lair
sections.intent: The approach to the regional boss's lair, fighting through elite guardians.
sections.end_condition: Artie reaches the inner sanctum of the regional boss.

sections.title: The One-Percent Roll
sections.intent: The final confrontation with the boss, requiring a massive, high-risk glitch to win.
sections.end_condition: The regional boss is defeated and the Stability Patch is dropped.

sections.title: Critical Exposure
sections.intent: The immediate aftermath where the victory triggers a global System alert.
sections.end_condition: Artie's exact location is broadcast to the entire world.

sections.title: Patching the Hole
sections.intent: Artie uses the loot to permanently stabilize his class mechanics.
sections.end_condition: The 'Stability Patch' is successfully integrated into Artie's character sheet.

sections.title: The Deletion Event
sections.intent: The System begins a zone reset to purge the anomaly (Artie).
sections.end_condition: Artie narrowly escapes the collapsing zone.

sections.title: New Region, New Problems
sections.intent: Set the stage for the next book as Artie enters a new territory.
sections.end_condition: Artie crosses the border into the next region as a global target.
